source.title: extra-eyes macOS and Linux cargo test matrix

acquisition.details: Ran `cargo test` on macOS host: 21 unit tests, 29 integration tests, and doc tests passed. Ran Linux validation in disposable Debian arm64 container using local postgres:15 image with source mounted read-only and build artifacts in /tmp: after installing cargo/git/ca-certificates, `cargo test` passed 21 unit tests, 29 integration tests, and doc tests. The first Linux attempt exposed a real timeout bug: killing only the shell wrapper left a child `sleep` holding stdout open until 5s. Fixed watcher timeout handling by spawning each watcher in its own process group and killing the group with SIGKILL on timeout; rerun passed.
